decks.name: LeetCode #136 - Single Number
decks.description: Find the single element in an array where every other element appears twice

cards.question: Single Number: Given a non-empty array of integers nums where every element appears twice except for one, find that single one. You must implement a solution with linear runtime complexity and use only constant extra space.

solutions.name: Bit Manipulation
solutions.explanation: Use XOR operation which has the property that a XOR a equals zero and a XOR zero equals a. XORing all numbers cancels out duplicates leaving only the single number.

semanticLines: Define function singleNumber that accepts array nums.
Initialize variable res to zero.
Loop through each number in nums.
XOR num with res and assign result back to res.
Return res.

solutions.timeDescription: Linear time because we traverse the array once
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant space because we only use a single variable to store the result
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given array [4, 1, 2, 1, 2]: res=0, XOR 4 gives 4, XOR 1 gives 5, XOR 2 gives 7, XOR 1 gives 6, XOR 2 gives 4. Return 4.

solutions.name: Hash Set
solutions.explanation: Use a set to track numbers. If a number is already in the set, remove it (found its pair). If not in set, add it. The remaining element is the single number.

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Sort the array so duplicate elements are adjacent. Iterate through pairs, if a pair matches skip both, otherwise return the non-matching element.

Check if element at i equals element at i plus one.
If equal, increment i by two to skip the pair.
If not equal, return element at index i as it is the single number.
After loop, return element at index i.
